provenance_note: Private audit record. The public guideline uses one exact source document. Verbatim pairs are unchanged saved question/answer records; adapted/new pairs are authored teaching examples authorized by the user, not observed model outputs. Good/Bad labels apply only to the illustrated criterion. No automated scores were used as human gold labels.

source.source_text: The invention provides a paint spraying method for a plastic shell of an electric bicycle. The paint spraying method comprises the steps that (1) degreasing is conducted, specifically, spraying and cleaning are conducted with an aqueous degreasing agent containing alkali liquor and a surface active agent, and oil dirt on the surface of plastic is removed through the saponification of alkali and animal and vegetable oil in a solution and the emulsion process of the surface active agent and mineral oil; degreasing comprises a pre-degreasing procedure and a degreasing procedure, the pre-degreasing procedure is conducted for 1-2 min, and the degreasing procedure is conducted for 2-3 min; and the spraying pressure is 0.1-0.2 MPa; and the aqueous degreasing agent is composed of 50-70 g/L of sodium hydroxide, 20-30 g/L of sodium phosphate, 10-20 g/L of sodium carbonate, and 5-10 g/L of the surface active agent; and (b) interface activation is conducted, specifically, treatment is conducted through an aqueous surface adjusting agent containing aqueous macromolecule, an indoor-temperature spraying is conducted for 1 min, and the spraying pressure is 0.05-0.1 MPa. The paint spraying method is applied to paint spraying of the plastic shell of the electric bicycle.

criteria.heading: Are the question and answer supported by the text? (Grounding)
criteria.definition: Grounding means that the document supports the answer and the factual assumptions in the question. Check chemical identities, conditions and the distinction between proposed uses and demonstrated effects. An exact quotation may answer the wrong question. Give at most 2 for an important unsupported statement. A statement presented for checking need not be true.
